input.prompt: Straight-on photo of a wall in a cheap rented room above a village bar, at night, lit only by a warm desk lamp from the lower left. On the wall hangs a large old cork board, completely empty except for a few loose pushpins and two strips of masking tape. Faded floral wallpaper around it, a light switch, a damp stain in one corner. Nothing written, no papers, no photos on the board. Realistic, slightly grainy, muted colors, deep shadows at the edges. 16:9 landscape.
